rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Connects LLMs to Kali Linux penetration testing tools through a Docker-containerized MCP server. Exposes 21 tools across reconnaissance, scanning, web security, password cracking, and exploitation categories including Nmap, SQLMap, Gobuster, Hydra, John, and Metasploit Framework. Runs in isolated Docker containers with automated provisioning and safety timeouts.
